svg.title: Protected Lung Parenchyma Segmentation V2
svg.desc: Detailed flow diagram from LIDC-IDRI DICOM or LNDb MHD input through protected bidirectional lung-mask segmentation, boundary repair, filtering, windowing, normalization, masking, validation, and output.
svg.text: Detailed end-to-end processing flow with representative CT visualizations
Discover local patient series and match pylidc study/series UIDs
Sort slices by ImagePositionPatient (z); apply RescaleSlope + RescaleIntercept
Discover .mhd headers and verify the referenced ElementDataFile payload
Load with SimpleITK and convert to axial array order
Load and validate the CT volume
Create one common in-memory representation before segmentation.
Build a sensitive candidate mask for every axial slice
The same candidate buffer is later reused during propagation to limit peak memory.
Only wide, flat geometry is removed
Select and clean a reliable reference slice
Search outward from the middle slice; prefer the nearest clean slice containing substantial left and right lungs.
2. Remove small peripheral components (< 2% image area)
3. Remove small central anterior trachea (< 0.69% image area)
4. Keep two largest components and fill holes
NO — evaluate the next closest slice
Process slices toward both volume ends while retaining the last valid mask as the reference.
Stop at the first schedule value
Finalize and repair the lung mask
Apply conservative cleanup independently to every propagated axial slice.
Binary closing with disk radius 16 in a padded crop
Process one slice at a time; use the original HU volume and the final binary mask.
Generated directly from the implemented pipeline
Validation: matching shapes • finite values • valid dtypes/ranges • zero background outside the final mask
